text.about-0: ABOUT ME / THE PERSON BEHIND THE PIXELS
text.about-2:
Hello! I’m Truong Thong.

You can call me Tom.
text.about-3: I’m Nguyen Thanh Truong Thong, a senior graphic designer based in Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam. My journey began with mathematics, moved into graphic design, and grew through agency teams, retail, e-commerce, and coffee brands.
text.about-4: I care about the idea behind an identity and the system that keeps it consistent. My strengths connect branding, concept development, visual systems, website and app design, and project management.
text.about-5: From Capcom and Nintendo to Neo Geo, games have been part of my life since childhood. Coffee, books, travel, and reading God’s Word give me space to pause, discover, and create with purpose.
text.about-7:
Senior Graphic Designer
Brand thinker. System builder.
Curious human. Player at heart.

A TEAM OF TOOLS.
ONE CREATIVE DIRECTION.
text.about-37: I combine AI agents across research, concept exploration, content, prototyping, and implementation. I connect their outputs into one coherent project, then review and refine the result with a designer’s judgment.
text.about-41: Agents support research, ideas, and prototypes.
text.about-43: One system, checked details, consistent delivery.

text.about-64:
A LITTLE HEAT.
A LOT OF CURIOSITY.
text.about-65: Off the screen, I enjoy cooking — trying, adjusting, and making something with my hands. That same playful curiosity follows me back into design.
text.about-68: A good coffee. A new city. A book I can get lost in. Guitar, cycling, music, cats, and little doodles. These are the things that keep life interesting beyond the design file.
text.about-69: Faith is part of who I am. Time in God’s Word helps shape the purpose and perspective I bring to life and work.
text.about-72: Games spark my imagination. Time in God’s Word restores my soul. Green pastures and still waters — a little reminder of Psalm 23.
